configurations.name: elbe-tour
runtimeArgs: import http.server as h, mimetypes; mimetypes.add_type('text/javascript','.js'); mimetypes.add_type('application/manifest+json','.webmanifest'); mimetypes.add_type('image/svg+xml','.svg'); h.test(HandlerClass=h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, port=8765)

configurations.name: elbe-tour-subpath
runtimeArgs: import http.server as h, mimetypes, functools; mimetypes.add_type('text/javascript','.js'); mimetypes.add_type('application/manifest+json','.webmanifest'); H=functools.partial(h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='..'); h.test(HandlerClass=H, port=8792)
